data.raw_text:
Tulong at koordinasyon sa mga emergency situation sa Metro Manila ang naging sentro ng talakayan sa courtesy visit sa Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) ng mga kinatawan ng National Capital Region Command (NCRCOM) at Veterans Memorial Medical Center (VMCC) ngayong araw.

Partikular na sinabi ni MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes ang assistance sa NCRCOM sa mga operasyon katulad ng rally, bagyo, lindol, at iba pang mga emerhensya sa Metro Manila.

Nagpasalamat din ang mga ahensiya sa bukas na koordinasyon at pagtutulungan upang higit pang mapaigting ang disaster preparedness ng Metro Manila.

#mmda

IN PHOTOS: Members of  Alab ng Bayan together with Tindig Pilipinas and various civil society, march during an indignation rally condemning the alleged “Senate coup” that led to changes in the leadership of the Senate of the Philippines, which they described as a desperate attempt to block the continuation of the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte, in Pasay City, May 13, 2026.  The groups also denounced the Senate leadership for allegedly protecting Senator Ronald dela Rosa, whom they accused of involvement in alleged extrajudicial killings, and called for his immediate arrest.

📷 Norman Cruz
